title: Michael Burry's Chilling Warning as $100 Oil Collides With AI Debt Explosion: 'Not Sure How Much Longer'
excerpt: Michael Burry is warning about a market collision: rising oil prices, an artificial intelligence debt binge and mounting pressure in long-duration Treasuries...
content_html:

Michael Burry is warning about a market collision: rising oil prices, an artificial intelligence debt binge and mounting pressure in long-duration Treasuries.

"Watch the long bonds," Burry wrote on X Thursday. He cited AI's "debt explosion," rising inflation volatility, a shaky Treasury basis trade and oil returning near $100. He concluded: "Not sure how much longer PE and PC can hold their breath," apparently referring to private equity and private credit markets.

Watch the long bonds. Treasuries pressured by AI's debt explosion, rising inflation vol, (per the great chart from @Bloomberg's Simon White). Basis Trade's shaky state, #oil back near 100, many factors, many charts. Not sure how much longer PE and PC can hold their breath. pic.twitter.com/QjohxACvIs

— Cassandra Unchained (@michaeljburry) July 23, 2026

Private equity and private credit, sectors that flourished when borrowing costs were low, could be particularly vulnerable to a sharp increase in inflation and interest rates. Higher bond-market yields could expose weak underwriting and debt structured for cheaper money.

That dynamic puts alternative-asset managers Blackstone Inc. and Apollo Global Management Inc. in focus. Both have private-equity and credit operations exposed to refinancing conditions, borrower health and asset valuations.

Stubbornly High Yields Echo 2007

The chart shared by Burry shows the 30-year Treasury yield has traded above 5% for 27 days in 2026. That compares with six days in 2025 and seven in 2023. The last comparable stretch came in 2007, in the run-up to the global financial crisis, when the yield spent 50 days above that threshold.

The iShares 20+ Year Treasury Bond ETF offers a liquid proxy for long-duration government bonds and generally falls when long-term yields rise.

AI spending adds another strain. Technology companies are tapping debt markets to finance data centers, chips, power and cooling. That issuance competes with heavy Treasury supply.

Oracle Corp., a cloud and data-center spender, offers an equity-market gauge of the debt-funded AI buildout. Its financing shows the AI race is spilling into credit markets.

迈克尔·伯里 (Michael Burry) 对市场冲突发出警告：油价上涨、人工智能债务狂潮以及长期国债压力不断加大。

“关注长期债券，”伯里在周四写道。 他列举了人工智能的“债务爆炸”、通胀波动性上升、国债基差贸易不稳定以及油价接近 100 美元的回报。 他的结论是：“不确定 PE 和 PC 还能屏住呼吸多久”，显然指的是私募股权和私人信贷市场。

留意长期债券。 美国国债受到人工智能债务爆炸、通货膨胀率上升的压力（根据@彭博社西蒙怀特的图表）。 基差交易的不稳定状态，#oil 回到 100 附近，有很多因素，很多图表。 不知道PE和PC还能屏住呼吸多久。 pic.twitter.com/QjohxACvIs — Cassandra Unchained (@michaeljburry) 2026 年 7 月 23 日

私募股权和私人信贷这些在借贷成本较低时蓬勃发展的行业可能特别容易受到通货膨胀和利率急剧上升的影响。 债券市场收益率上升可能会暴露承销疲软以及为廉价资金而构建的债务。

这种动态使另类资产管理公司 Blackstone Inc. 和 Apollo Global Management Inc. 成为焦点。 两家公司的私募股权和信贷业务都面临再融资条件、借款人健康状况和资产估值的影响。

顽固高产回声 2007

Burry 分享的图表显示，2026 年 30 年期国债收益率已连续 27 天保持在 5% 以上。 相比之下，2025 年为 6 天，2023 年为 7 天。 最后一次类似的增长发生在 2007 年，全球金融危机爆发前夕，当时收益率持续 50 天高于这一阈值。

趋势：避免第一大投资错误：你的“安全”持仓可能会让你付出巨大的代价

iShares 20+ 年期国债 ETF 为长期政府债券提供了流动性替代品，并且当长期收益率上升时通常会下跌。

人工智能支出增加了另一个压力。 科技公司正在利用债务市场为数据中心、芯片、电力和冷却设备提供融资。 此次发行与大量国债供应形成竞争。

甲骨文公司是一家云和数据中心支出公司，提供了债务融资的人工智能建设的股票市场指标。 它的融资表明人工智能竞赛正在蔓延到信贷市场。
